annotations.title: Group structure summary for a company

description: A summary of one entity's place in the group-structure file (GLEIF relationship records, golden copy): whether the file holds a current direct and a current ultimate accounting consolidating parent for it, and how many current direct subsidiaries it has there, with the golden-copy date. Summary only, the same for every key: no names, LEIs, register numbers, periods or percentages; the reply says how the relationships themselves are supplied. The file covers relationships where the child or the parent has its legal address in the United States, the United Kingdom, Germany, France, Italy or Spain. Input: id, a ticker (e.g. FOXF, or a register-number ticker such as 493455042.FR) or a 20-character LEI.

id.description: A ticker (e.g. FOXF, 493455042.FR) or a 20-character LEI
